body.name: Full-initial-law counterfactual path
body.construction: Use the displayed \(\Psi_T\): integrate the first message and its square under the joint law \(P_{0X}\), then, only after the first dense interaction, integrate each later message under \(P_X\) and an independent Gaussian state with recursively updated mean and variance; take \(\theta_T=(m_t^{(1)}-m_t^{(0)})_{t=1}^T\).
